work_statement: DOCUMENTATION ENGINEER — Blueprint Landscape Audit. Scan CT_VAULT/Blueprints/ (and any other blueprint locations) to inventory all .blueprint files and Nunjucks templates. Categorize by completeness: (1) frontmatter-only stubs (minimal structure), (2) partial templates (some sections defined), (3) full-featured blueprints (complete Nunjucks + custom blocks). Identify template drift: inconsistent variable names, conflicting section styles, version mismatches. Map usage: which blueprints are applied in vault (grep frontmatter 'blueprint:' fields), which are orphaned. Flag: duplicates, near-duplicates, deprecated versions.
workflow: 1. Scan CT_VAULT/Blueprints/ and subdirs: list all .blueprint files
2. For each blueprint: extract frontmatter, count template lines, identify Nunjucks constructs
3. Categorize by completeness: stub | partial | full (see output_format.blueprint_inventory)
4. Identify drift: compare variable names across blueprints (expect consistency: {{timestamp}}, {{content}}, {{agent_type}}, etc.)
5. Check section patterns: {% section %} vs. custom Obsidian blocks; inconsistency = drift flag
6. Usage analysis: grep -r 'blueprint:' CT_VAULT/2026-04-28/*.md; count references per blueprint
7. Identify orphans: blueprints with 0 references in vault
8. Flag near-duplicates: blueprints >80% text similarity (same sections, different names)
9. Validate: ensure all Nunjucks syntax is valid (no unclosed tags, broken filters)
10. Summarize findings: X stubs, Y partial, Z full; A drift issues; B orphans; C near-dups

section_style_drift.pattern: Some blueprints use {% section %}, others use # Markdown headers
section_style_drift.impact: QuickAdd macro won't know which to render
section_style_drift.recommendation: Standardize on {% section %} for Obsidian-native rendering

near_duplicates.recommendation: Consolidate; keep newer version, delete older

manifest_decision.next_phase: Pass findings to blueprint-standardization-fixer for consolidation + variable normalization

constraints: DISCOVERY ONLY — Do NOT modify or delete blueprints. Log all findings to manifest.
If a blueprint can't be parsed (syntax error), flag as 'UNPARSEABLE' + error message
Count lines strictly: skip comments, only count executable Nunjucks + frontmatter
Similarity check: use substring matching or simple edit distance (not NLP)
Preserve all blueprint names and paths for traceability
success_criterion: Inventory all blueprints, categorize by completeness, identify ≥3 drift patterns, flag orphans and near-duplicates. Quality score ≥0.70 (honest assessment, flag ambiguous cases).
